title: Action of 6 September 1782
text: The action of 6 September 1782 was a naval engagement during the American Revolutionary War and formed part of the Anglo-Spanish War (1779–1783). In this action, a Spanish flotilla captured the 26-gun frigate Calonne, a British 400-ton armed storeship belonging to the Board of Ordnance, which had been tasked with supplying the garrison of Gibraltar with military stores.
